OPERATOR OVERRIDE of the 18:05 AC2 recommendation (the advisor invited this; the operator confirmed it in the product session at 17:59; recorded by product). Implement AC2' from the 18:00 comment, NOT "default vendor = claude":
- Keep `[agents] vendor = "codex"`. Codex is the priority vendor (its user base comes first), and the repo's own lanes are meant to run on Codex to shake out gaps.
- Add `[contained.vendors] codex = "native"`; Claude stays fully AIDA-contained; native is reported everywhere as "native sandbox, not AIDA-contained".
- Correction to the 18:05 premise: "Codex stays available via --vendor codex under its contained-autonomous posture" is not true today. Under containment, both `aida agent new codex` and `queue work --vendor codex` refuse (refuse_uncontainable_agent_tool, require_vendor_containment). AC2' is what makes that path real.
- Lane vendor: the operator wants this implemented BY A CODEX AGENT. If the queued lane would launch Claude, hold it; the operator is starting a Codex implementer in the TASK-2631 worktree by hand.
subject: TASK-2631: operator overrides AC2 (keep codex default, native opt-in); hold any Claude lane
